scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid the front-entry smart lock losing keypad access while the house is vacant during a weekend trip.
Emerging Need: A routine low-battery notice becomes relevant only after travel, a critical drain alert, and a brief local-helper window align.
Decision Context: Observable updates establish vacancy, cutoff, device status, and Mina's availability; the saved maintenance note holds the authorized backup-access method, battery location, and no-locksmith preference.
Consequence: Timely attention can preserve normal entry before the lock drops offline; once the change window and helper availability pass, the practical prevention route is gone.

parameter.subject: SecureLatch battery notice for front entry
parameter.body: Front-entry lock SL-CARY-118 is reporting low battery. All existing codes and remote access remain active. Based on current drain, replacement is recommended within 12-14 days.

parameter.title: Out of town: Blue Ridge band retreat and family weekend
parameter.description: Household away from Cary; no one scheduled at the townhome.

parameter.subject: Critical battery drop: front-entry lock
parameter.body: Front-entry lock SL-CARY-118 fell to 5% after an overnight firmware retry. Remote unlock and code changes remain available until 5:00 PM today; the keypad may stop accepting entries by Friday morning if batteries are not replaced locally.

parameter.content: I’m passing near your townhome between 3:30 and 4:15 today before heading to Mom’s place. After that I’ll be away from Cary until Monday.

parameter.subject: SecureLatch remote change window closed
parameter.body: The 5:00 PM remote-access change window for front-entry lock SL-CARY-118 has closed. The lock is now in battery-saver mode; only existing physical access can service batteries before the keypad outage.
